# Phrases every generated AGENTS.md must carry, one per line, matched as fixed
# strings (case-sensitive) against the generated file.
#
# This list exists because the instruction is prose, and prose is the one thing
# in this repository nothing else checks. A discipline dropped from the template
# during an edit would otherwise be invisible until an agent did the thing the
# missing sentence was there to prevent -- printed a resolved credential, turned
# an absence in a view into a claim about the world, edited a governed document
# instead of proposing a correction.
#
# Each line is a phrase, not a sentence: the wording around it may be improved
# without breaking the check, and the discipline itself may not go missing. The
# plan names six of these by hand -- "never print", "before claiming",
# "conditional", "propose", "output_root", "RETAINED" -- and the rest are the
# remaining disciplines the thin instruction is required to carry.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# The six the plan names.
never print
before claiming
conditional
propose
output_root
RETAINED

# Reaching the view, the scripts and the outputs through the binding rather than
# through a path relative to where this directory sits (R47).
documents_root
framework_root
Individual document

# Read only what the task needs.
Read only the fields

# The secret discipline, both halves: a bounded subprocess, and no resolved
# value anywhere.
bounded subprocess

# What must not be written.
Never edit a governed document
Do not publish

# Say what was needed rather than improvising.
Say what you needed

# The task-time join, stated once.
task-time join

# Provenance is on every fact, not on the file.
source: <document-id>@<release>

# A copy does not update its own retention status; a link does.
point-in-time snapshot
written for the document's MAINTAINER
test -L

# This machine's own copies and tools live in the Individual binding, never in a
# shared document or a view (R10): the instruction names where to look.
local_resources
path_purposes
